{{Quote|Here we stand, at the extremity of our exertion, having cast behind us the idols of our fathers, to once again carry to our foe the penalties due their sacrileges. Come perdition or hard vacuum, the Republic expects that every citizen will do his duty.|[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Contispex I/Legends|Contispex I]], ''Fourth Inaugural Oration''|<ref name="TTSP">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/praji/20090205.html|text=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji|int=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji}}</ref>}}
The '''Contispex dynasty''' was a ideological discourse of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellors]] who were adherers of the [[Pius Dea]] [[humanocentrism]] religious sect and presided over a theocratic authoritarian [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for a [[Pius Dea Era|millennium]]. Many in the hierarchy were descended from its founder [[Contispex I/Legends|Contispex I]], including his son [[Contispex II]]. The last Pius Dea member in power was [[Contispex XIX]], who was captured by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] aboard the ''[[Flame of Sinthara]]'' and taken to [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]], where he was tried and imprisoned for the rest of his life.
